name: dhi
description: Personal document Q&A over a Google Drive folder of PDFs, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, TXT, MD, CSV, and RTF files organized into topic subfolders. Pulls documents live via the Drive connector and indexes them -- including embedded images via vision -- into a local SQLite index, without ever copying the source documents to local disk, and answers questions strictly from that content, always citing document + page/section + topic, saying "I don't know" when the documents don't cover it.
